# RunPod A40 env — install ON TOP of the image's existing torch. DO NOT reinstall torch.
#
# Image in use: runpod/pytorch:1.0.2-cu1281-torch280-ubuntu2404
#   -> torch 2.8.0, CUDA 12.8.1, Ubuntu 24.04 (Python 3.12 or 3.13 — CHECK on connect)
#
# PROCEDURE (exact order):
#
#   1) Read the image's versions FIRST:
#        python -c "import sys, torch; print(sys.version)"
#        python -c "import torch; print(torch.__version__, torch.version.cuda)"
#        python -c "import torchvision, torchaudio; print(torchvision.__version__, torchaudio.__version__)"
#
#   2) Write those EXACT strings into env/constraints-pod.txt, e.g.:
#        torch==2.8.0
#        torchvision==0.23.0
#        torchaudio==2.8.0
#
#   3) Install with the constraints file so pip is FORBIDDEN from touching torch:
#        pip install -c env/constraints-pod.txt -r env/requirements-pod.txt
#
#   4) RE-VERIFY torch did not move:
#        python -c "import torch; print(torch.__version__, torch.version.cuda)"
#      If it changed, the CUDA stack is broken — RESTART THE POD, do not try to repair it.
#
#   5) Lock what actually resolved:
#        pip freeze > env/requirements-pod.lock
#
# NEVER install: tensorflow, keras, vllm, bitsandbytes, flash-attn.
#   - vllm hard-pins torch and will rewrite the image's CUDA stack. HF `generate` with
#     left-padded batching costs ~$1.50 more in total and cannot break the environment.
#   - flash-attn needs 30-60 min of PAID compile time. Use attn_implementation="sdpa".
#   - bitsandbytes is unnecessary: bf16 Qwen2-Audio-7B is ~17 GB, fits 48 GB with room.
#
# NO librosa / numba / llvmlite. `zeroshot.py` reads audio with soundfile alone: MELD is
# already 16 kHz so nothing needs resampling, and numba 0.60 caps at Python 3.12 — on a
# 3.13 image it would fail to build. One less version trap.
#
# FLOORS, NOT EXACT PINS. The earlier exact set (transformers==4.51.3, trl==0.16.1) was
# chosen for torch 2.4 and predates torch 2.8; forcing it risks a stale-API mismatch.
# Floors let pip pick a contemporaneous set, and step 5 locks whatever it chose.
#
# Set before running anything:
#   export USE_TF=0 TRANSFORMERS_NO_TF=1

transformers>=4.51          # Qwen2-Audio needs >=4.45; 4.51+ for the newer processor API
accelerate>=1.4
peft>=0.14
trl>=0.16                   # GRPOTrainer (Phase 4 only; not needed for Phase 3)
datasets>=3.3

soundfile>=0.12             # audio I/O — no librosa, no numba
numpy>=1.26,<3

pandas
pyarrow
scikit-learn
wandb
